completeSharedRules.status: NEW complete current local DE4 proposal only; original shared proposal retained separately. No adopted rule or source is changed.
completeSharedRules.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
completeSharedRules.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
completeSharedRules.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. Current accepted expedition/faction procedures now supply their actual records and social limits. This spell proposal grants no membership, standing, allied status, permission, roster or institution merely by requesting information.
completeSharedRules.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
completeSharedRules.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
completeSharedRules.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.
completeSharedRules.DE4-GUARD-01: NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.

completeCardUnchanged.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and the sphere blocking spells of fifth level/Tier 5 or lower. NEW the operative measure is the original generating spell's actual rank 0 through 5; Tier here means spell rank, not material tier, class level, RP paid or a name-based estimate. An actually authorized rank-changing source uses its real generating rank; discounts/surcharges alone change no rank. Preserve the original conflicting terminology and Instantaneous metadata. NEW create one fixed 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range/line of effect, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. It is nonphysical, supplies no cover/support/collision and does not follow its caster.

NEW block a qualifying spell's new local application to a creature/object/point inside the globe when that component's genuine authorized origin is outside the globe at resolution. Use the actual originating body/legally authorized remote source, not arbitrary animation graphics or the target's position as a fabricated origin. Origin on the boundary counts outside; a recipient intersecting the protected interior is protected as a whole discrete body/item. Outgoing spells from inside and spells genuinely originating inside remain legal, including against inside recipients. An outside-to-outside spell path can pass through without protecting its outside recipient; this is a recipient ward, not an opaque antimagic wall. A spell's nonspell costs/casting commitments and concentration still occur; blocking its payload gives no refund or retroactive Counterspell.

For multi-target spells, prevent only qualifying protected recipient applications. Other targets remain independently legal. An outside-origin instantaneous area can resolve elsewhere, but its protected interior recipients receive no damage, condition, healing, teleport-arrival or created object/body application from that low-rank component. A genuine arrival originating outside is checked at its destination: a protected destination leaves the transported body at its actual origin under the transport source's ordinary failure rule, without free retargeting. This is not a general planar rule. A created summon outside can later move inside physically; its already-created real body does not become a new cast on every step. Its source-defined ordinary nonspell attack is not automatically blocked merely because a low-rank spell created it.

Existing creature-attached buffs/curses and completed instantaneous changes are not dispelled, suspended or ended when the globe forms or a bearer walks in. An already-established externally anchored ongoing area of rank 0-5 has only its covered local ongoing expression blocked while the globe applies; original concentration, duration, spent ticks and exterior effects continue. No queued pulse on leaving/expiry. A genuine new reapplication counts as new, not as protected historical work. Spell-granted intrinsic weapon enchantments remain established benefits; a newly triggered independent spell payload with its own actual originating interface is checked separately, without converting the entire physical weapon hit into a spell. Nonspell class abilities, ordinary projectiles, magical item engines and rank6+ spells are unaffected unless their actual source expressly makes them eligible spell components.

The globe itself is rank6. An outside lower-rank attempt aimed at its protected anchor is blocked even if that attempt would otherwise have a higher-rank dispel procedure; an inside eligible dispel, rank6+ source or actual explicit ward-bypass permission retains its scope. A spell that expressly ignores spell blocking overrides only this barrier component, not cover or unrelated legality. Suppression removes the globe's local protection while the original clock runs; it does not suppress every protected creature's unrelated magic. Concentration ending, expiry or actual removal ends it. Multiple globes supply the union of their operative protected volumes, no stronger rank ceiling; adjudicate origin/recipient against each separately. One active globe per caster, with normal concentration commitment and successful replacement rules. No hidden spell-rank or effect inventory is reported to the caster.

completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.procedure:
KEEP Action, 30 feet, V/S/F, all targets forgetting the last minute, INT resistance and instantaneous resolution. NEW center one 30-foot-radius sphere on the caster. Snapshot every creature in the sphere with caster-origin line of effect, including the caster and allies; no selective omission or individual-perception requirement. A hidden creature can be affected without being revealed. Each makes INT. Success leaves memory unchanged. Failure removes accessible firsthand episodic recall of experiences during the 60 elapsed seconds immediately preceding resolution, but only experiences that the creature actually had. Unconscious intervals with no experience, absent witnesses and beings without the relevant memory capacity do not acquire fabricated experiences or a substitute older interval. No shared language or sight of the spell is needed; actual mental/memory protections retain their scope.

NEW this is an instantaneous lasting memory change, not a one-minute ongoing fog. There is no concentration, expiry, concealed area, visual obscuration, continuing entrant effect, replacement narrative or private-memory readout. Ordinary dispelling or later antimagic does not undo a completed alteration. The recipient cannot recall a newly heard password solely through the erased experience, but existing independent older knowledge and external notes remain available. General identity, trained proficiencies, actual class/repertoire grants, completed legitimate training and older memories are not deleted merely because the creature used or thought about them during that minute. Events, injuries, statuses, resources, consumptions, actions, contracts and all other people's unaffected evidence remain real. This source does not independently end concentration; Disrupt Memory's explicit concentration-ending clause is not a universal memory rule.

Record the actual original episode/event provenance before applying the inaccessible-memory layer. Each new cast has its own resolution-relative last-minute window. Erasing a present recollection of yesterday does not erase yesterday's underlying memory, and revisiting an older fabricated story cannot reset its event date. Repeated paid casts over genuinely passing time can affect additional genuinely recent intervals; this source supplies no overall one-minute lifetime cap, but it also supplies no backdated or recursive reach. Empty or protected portions give no hidden diagnostic and cannot be substituted with another person's experiences. Actual noticing of a gap, suspicion, testimony and investigation remain possible without an automatic identification of the caster.

NEW recovery proposal: a genuinely applicable effect expressly restoring altered memories uses its own procedure. Otherwise, after encountering specific credible independent evidence contradicting the alteration or establishing an erased event, the recipient may spend ten uninterrupted minutes examining that episode and make WIS/Insight. Use the highest original spell DC among currently operative Haze of Forgetting and Woven Threads alterations covering the selected episode. Ordinary task degrees apply: Success/Critical Success restores the actual originally experienced portion; failure provides no false certainty, and a retry needs materially new evidence or method. The same unsupported assertion is not infinite retries. This shared recovery rule is an explicit proposed extension to the prior unadopted Woven Threads draft, requiring joint agreement; it is not silently applied as a reviewed correction.

On successful recovery under this new shared rule, remove the current Haze/Woven overlays over the recovered portion and restore the true original episode, not an earlier adversary's invented layer. Unrelated intervals and other named memory effects retain their own rules. Disrupt Memory's reviewed six-second firsthand loss does not gain this new evidence-restoration permission merely by overlap; if that independent effect still removes a portion, learning evidence can create new knowledge without overriding its own recovery rules. Death/revival, rests, initiative changes and recasts do not reset the retained memory provenance. The spell dictates no future belief or decision based on the missing interval and cannot manufacture consent by making someone forget an objection.
workedCases: EN6-02-A: At elapsed time 120, the caster and three witnesses stand inside the 30-foot sphere. All four make INT, including the caster. Failed saves affect their actually experienced interval from time 60 up to resolution at 120. A witness asleep for the first thirty seconds loses only actual later experience. The spilled ink, spent RP, wounds and a written receipt remain unchanged; the spell supplies neither a replacement story nor an announcement of which hidden witnesses failed.

EN6-02-B: A genuine episode is covered by a DC16 Haze layer and a DC18 Woven Threads alteration. With credible independent evidence, ten minutes of examination uses Insight DC18 under the explicitly new shared recovery proposal. Success restores the true experienced portion and removes those two proposal-family overlays; it does not erase an independent Disrupt Memory prohibition or grant facts never observed. A later low-DC recast cannot lower this recovery DC or use a present recollection to reach older original events.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.newChoices: NEW self-centered all-creature sphere including self, lasting episodic loss, actual event-window conservation and explicit Haze/Woven shared evidence-recovery extension without changing reviewed Disrupt Memory.
completeEarlierRecordUnchanged.originalQuestion: Preserve ALL targets within30ft FORGETTING THE LAST1MINUTE with INT SAVE RESISTING,Core Action/range30ft/Instantaneous. Define center,three-dimensional area,eligible actual target snapshot,perception/line and whether the caster chooses recipients or all qualifying creatures are affected. Fix the remembered time interval and persistent versus temporary loss,including unconscious or absent witnesses and later recovery/dispel/suppression. Compare Woven Threads and existing memory spells: this erases a recent interval rather than automatically providing replacement memories or reading secrets. Actual events,injuries,records,resource spending,training and present conditions remain real. Repeated casts cannot extend the window by resetting its start or create unlimited knowledge loss. No fog-based concealment,global witness search or guaranteed immunity to suspicion is inferred.
